verdict.rationale: Kit's V4 API documents campaign (broadcast) performance endpoints: per-broadcast stats for recipients, opens, clicks, unsubscribes and rates; a batch stats endpoint for a page of broadcasts; and per-link click performance. Account-level email and growth stats, cursor pagination up to 1000 per page, and 5-year stats retention support pulling this data into a warehouse. The evidence shows no API for flow, sequence or automation performance metrics, so only the campaign half of the story is covered. Missing for 10: flow/sequence/automation performance metrics via the API, a native warehouse export or connector, independent or hands-on corroboration.
